title: Create GitHub issue templates
description: Create issue templates in .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/: bug_report.md, feature_request.md, and config.yml to disable blank issues and link to discussions if applicable.

title: Configure test coverage reporting
description: Set up coverage configuration: .coveragerc or Go coverage flags in Makefile, coverage threshold enforcement in CI, and coverage badge for README.

title: Gate 3: Lifecycle Control Review
description:
Quality gate after Iteration 3. Complete manual testing checklist, refactoring considerations, code quality checks, and documentation updates per docs/IMPLEMENTATION-APPROACH.md.

Key checks:
- Start/stop work from CLI and TUI
- Operations are idempotent
- Ctrl+C cancels gracefully
- No goroutine leaks (go test -race)
- Operation abstraction pattern established
- CLI commands and TUI keybindings documented

title: Define CLI command structure
description: Define the Cobra command hierarchy for cloudcoop CLI mode. Commands should mirror TUI capabilities: status, start, stop, resize, agents (list/add/kill/connect). Include --json output flag for scriptability. Document in cmd/ directory structure. CLI runs when subcommands provided; TUI launches when no args given.

title: Iteration 8: Configuration & Polish
description:
Production-ready user experience.

Deliverables:
- Config file support: ~/.config/cloudcoop/config.yaml
- cloudcoop config show displays current configuration
- cloudcoop config set <key> <value> updates configuration
- First-run detection with setup wizard prompt
- Comprehensive error messages with actionable hints
- --help text polished for all commands

Proves: Real-world usability, configuration persistence, user onboarding flow.

Exit criteria: New user can install, configure, and use cloudcoop without reading docs.

Note: Can be done in parallel after Iteration 3.

title: Create CI lint workflow
description: Create .github/workflows/lint.yml with jobs for: Go linting (golangci-lint), YAML linting, Markdown linting, GitHub Actions linting, shell script linting. Include gatekeeper job for branch protection. Use path filtering and concurrency control.

title: Post-MVP Enhancements
description: Future enhancements to cloudcoop after MVP is complete. These features are nice-to-haves that improve the user experience but aren't required for core functionality. Includes: terminal config generation, cost tracking, multi-VM support, additional cloud providers, and other conveniences.

title: Terminal config generator (Ghostty/iTerm2/Kitty)
description: Generate optimized terminal emulator configuration for multi-agent viewing. Creates config files or shell scripts to launch terminal with pre-configured panes, each connected to a different agent session. Supports grid layouts (e.g., 4x3 for 12 agents). This is a convenience feature for power users who want simultaneous visibility of multiple agents without using tmux window navigation. Core workflow uses tmux directly.

title: Create CI build workflow
description: Create .github/workflows/build.yml to build binaries for multiple platforms: linux/amd64, linux/arm64, darwin/amd64, darwin/arm64, windows/amd64. Use matrix strategy. Upload artifacts for verification.

title: Go Tooling Configuration
description: Configure Go-specific development tooling including golangci-lint configuration, Makefile with standard targets (build, test, lint, clean), go.mod initialization, and CLI command structure using Cobra with Bubbletea TUI integration.

title: Create .editorconfig
description: Create .editorconfig with root=true, UTF-8 charset, LF line endings, final newline, trim trailing whitespace. Go files: tabs with indent_size=4. YAML/JSON/Markdown: spaces with indent_size=2. Makefiles: tabs.

title: Create CI test workflow
description: Create .github/workflows/test.yml to run Go tests with coverage reporting. Test on ubuntu-latest with Go matrix (1.21, 1.22). Upload coverage to Codecov or similar. Include caching for Go modules.

title: Create .gitattributes with Go and binary settings
description: Create .gitattributes with text=auto eol=lf, binary file patterns (images, fonts, archives), Go-specific patterns (*.go text diff=golang), and linguist overrides for docs.

title: Iteration 3: VM Lifecycle Control
description:
Prove write operations and async operation handling.

Deliverables:
- cloudcoop start starts a stopped VM, waits for RUNNING state
- cloudcoop stop stops a running VM, waits for STOPPED state
- TUI keybindings: S to start, T to stop
- Progress indicator during long-running operations
- Idempotent behavior (start when running = no-op with message)

Proves: GCP mutation operations, long-running operation polling, TUI state updates during async work.

Exit criteria: User can start/stop VM from both CLI and TUI.

title: Create .goreleaser.yml configuration
description: Configure GoReleaser for: multi-platform builds (linux/darwin/windows, amd64/arm64), changelog generation from commits, GitHub Releases publishing, binary naming convention (cloudcoop_OS_ARCH), and archive formats.

title: Create .golangci.yml configuration
description: Create golangci-lint config with sensible defaults for a TUI project. Enable linters: errcheck, gosimple, govet, ineffassign, staticcheck, unused, gofmt, goimports, misspell, revive. Configure reasonable timeouts and exclusions.

title: Iteration 1: CLI/TUI Skeleton
description:
Prove the hybrid CLI/TUI pattern works with build pipeline.

Deliverables:
- cloudcoop (no args) launches minimal Bubbletea TUI displaying static placeholder
- cloudcoop version prints version string
- cloudcoop status prints mock/hardcoded status
- Binary builds for darwin/linux on arm64/amd64
- CI pipeline runs tests and builds

Proves: Cobra + Bubbletea integration, cross-platform builds, CI/CD pipeline functionality.

Exit criteria: User can run cloudcoop and see TUI, run cloudcoop status and see mock output.

title: GitHub Repository Configuration
description: Set up GitHub-specific configuration: CODEOWNERS, pull request template, issue templates, dependabot configuration for Go modules and GitHub Actions, and actionlint configuration.

title: Create Homebrew formula template
description: Create Homebrew formula template for cloudcoop installation via brew. Can be generated by GoReleaser or maintained separately in a homebrew-tap repository.

title: Create linter configuration files
description:
Create configuration files for linters used by pre-commit and CI:
- .yamllint.yaml (line-length: 160, truthy check-keys: false)
- .markdownlint.json (line-length: 120, allow details/summary/br)
- .github/actionlint.yaml (self-hosted runner labels, config variables)
- .prettierrc and .prettierignore (for JSON/YAML/Markdown formatting)

These are referenced by pre-commit hooks and CI workflows.

title: Iteration 2: GCP Authentication & Read
description:
Prove GCP SDK integration and credential flow.

Deliverables:
- Authenticate using Application Default Credentials (ADC)
- cloudcoop status queries real VM instance from Compute API
- TUI displays real VM status (name, state, zone, machine type)
- Graceful handling when VM not found (with setup hint)
- Configuration for project/zone/instance name

Proves: GCP Compute SDK integration, ADC credential discovery, error handling patterns.

Exit criteria: User with valid GCP credentials sees real VM status.

title: Gate 7: Interactive Connect Review
description:
Quality gate after Iteration 7. Complete manual testing checklist, refactoring considerations, code quality checks, and documentation updates per docs/IMPLEMENTATION-APPROACH.md.

Key checks:
- Connect attaches to correct tmux window
- Terminal state restored after disconnect
- Resize and special characters work
- Signals handled correctly
- PTY allocation works on all platforms
- tmux navigation keys documented

title: Release Automation
description: Configure automated release process using GoReleaser or similar. Include: multi-platform binary builds, changelog generation, GitHub Releases integration, and optional homebrew formula generation.

title: Git Configuration
description: Set up .gitignore and .gitattributes files tailored for a Golang project. Include common patterns for Go builds, IDE files, secrets, and binary outputs.

title: Gate 1: Foundation Review
description:
Quality gate after Iteration 1. Complete manual testing checklist, refactoring considerations, code quality checks, and documentation updates per docs/IMPLEMENTATION-APPROACH.md.

Key checks:
- CLI/TUI launches and exits cleanly
- Binary runs on all target platforms
- CI pipeline passes
- Package structure is clean (cmd/, internal/tui/, internal/config/, internal/cloud/)
- go vet and golangci-lint pass
- README updated with build/run instructions
- CLAUDE.md exists (created via repo config task cloud-coop-c1r)

title: Gate 5: Agent Read Review
description:
Quality gate after Iteration 5. Complete manual testing checklist, refactoring considerations, code quality checks, and documentation updates per docs/IMPLEMENTATION-APPROACH.md.

Key checks:
- Agent list works with 0, 1, and 20+ agents
- tmux not installed handled gracefully
- Agent model struct defined cleanly
- tmux parser has unit tests with real output samples
- Malformed tmux output doesn't crash

title: Create .markdownlint.json configuration
description: Create markdownlint config with: line-length 120 (tables/code_blocks/headings excluded), allow inline HTML for details/summary/br elements.

title: Create CLAUDE.md
description: Create CLAUDE.md with project overview, architecture summary, key commands (make build, make test, make lint), and important constraints/patterns for AI assistant context. Reference TUI-REQUIREMENTS.md and ADRs.

title: Create CONTRIBUTING.md
description: Create CONTRIBUTING.md with: development setup instructions, code style guidelines (Go conventions), PR process, testing requirements, commit message format, and how to run linters locally.

title: Create Dependabot auto-merge workflow
description: Create GitHub Actions workflow that auto-merges Dependabot PRs for non-major version updates. Use dependabot/fetch-metadata and gh pr merge with appropriate permissions.

title: Tracer Bullet Implementation (MVP)
description: Implement cloudcoop using a tracer bullet approach with 8 iterations, each building a vertical slice through all architecture layers. Each iteration is followed by a quality gate for testing, refactoring, and documentation. See docs/IMPLEMENTATION-APPROACH.md for full details.

title: Document VM provisioning prerequisites
description: Create documentation for users on how to provision and configure their GCP VM before using cloudcoop. Should cover: gcloud commands to create VM with recommended settings (spot, boot-disk-auto-delete=no), IAP setup, SSH key configuration, basic VM setup (tmux installation, user creation). Reference existing docs/SPOT-RESILIENCE.md but consolidate into a clear setup guide.

title: Iteration 4: SSH Connectivity
description:
Prove remote command execution path.

Deliverables:
- Establish SSH connection to VM using Go SSH library
- cloudcoop ssh <command> runs arbitrary command, prints output
- SSH key discovery (standard locations, SSH agent)
- TUI shows connection status indicator
- Graceful handling of connection failures

Proves: SSH authentication and key handling, network connectivity to VM, remote command execution.

Exit criteria: User can run cloudcoop ssh hostname and see VM hostname.

title: Iteration 6: Agent Sessions (Write)
description:
Prove full agent lifecycle control.

Deliverables:
- cloudcoop agents add [--name=NAME] [--command=CMD] creates tmux window
- cloudcoop agents kill <index> kills tmux window by index
- TUI keybindings: A to add, K to kill (with confirmation)
- Default command configurable (e.g., claude --dangerously-skip-permissions)
- Prevent killing window with active process (warning + force flag)

Proves: Bidirectional tmux control, agent creation with custom commands, safe deletion with confirmation.

Exit criteria: User can create and destroy agent sessions from CLI and TUI.

title: Documentation Structure
description: Establish documentation structure with CONTRIBUTING.md, CLAUDE.md for AI assistant context, and organized docs/ directory for guides and architecture documentation.

title: Create .gitignore for Go project
description: Create .gitignore with Go-specific patterns: bin/, vendor/, *.exe, *.test, *.out, coverage files. Also include IDE patterns (.idea/, .vscode/), OS files (.DS_Store), secrets (.env*, *.pem, *.key), and build outputs.

title: Create Makefile with standard targets
description: Create Makefile with targets: build (go build), test (go test ./...), test-coverage (with coverage report), lint (golangci-lint run), fmt (gofmt -w), clean (remove bin/), install (go install), all. Include variables for binary name, version, ldflags.

title: Create .github/dependabot.yml
description: Configure Dependabot for: gomod (Go modules) weekly on Monday with deps(go) prefix and grouping, github-actions weekly with ci prefix. Include appropriate ignore patterns for major version bumps if needed.

title: Repository Configuration & CI/CD Setup
description: Configure this repository with mature development practices, CI/CD pipelines, and tooling appropriate for a Golang TUI/CLI project (cloudcoop). The tool will offer both an interactive TUI (default when no args) and scriptable CLI subcommands for automation. This includes git configuration, pre-commit hooks, GitHub Actions workflows, testing infrastructure, and release automation.

title: Create .github/actionlint.yaml
description: Create actionlint configuration with self-hosted runner labels (if any) and config-variables for any repository variables used in workflows.

title: Create .github/pull_request_template.md
description: Create PR template with sections: Summary, Changes (bulleted list), Test Plan (checklist), Related Issues, and Checklist (code standards, no sensitive data, docs updated, CI passes).

title: CI/CD Workflows
description: Create GitHub Actions workflows for: linting (Go, YAML, Markdown, Actions), testing with coverage, building for multiple platforms (linux/darwin, amd64/arm64), and gatekeeper jobs for branch protection.

title: Pre-commit Hooks Setup
description: Configure pre-commit framework with hooks for: trailing whitespace, YAML/JSON validation, large files, merge conflicts, private key detection, branch protection, Go formatting (gofmt/goimports), golangci-lint, and markdown/YAML linting.

title: Create .github/CODEOWNERS
description: Create CODEOWNERS file with default owner for all files, specific owners for docs/, .github/, and test directories.

title: Iteration 7: Interactive Connect
description:
Prove interactive terminal handoff.

Deliverables:
- cloudcoop connect <index> shells out to SSH, attaches to tmux window
- TUI keybinding: C to connect to selected agent
- Clean terminal state on exit (restore after SSH disconnect)
- Option to re-launch TUI after disconnect or exit completely

Proves: PTY handling for interactive sessions, terminal state management, TUI suspend/resume or exit flow.

Exit criteria: User can connect to agent, interact, detach, and return.

title: Editor Configuration
description: Set up .editorconfig for consistent formatting across editors. Configure Go-specific settings (tabs, indent size) and general settings for other file types (YAML, Markdown, Makefiles).

title: Gate 8: Polish Review
description:
Quality gate after Iteration 8. Complete manual testing checklist, refactoring considerations, code quality checks, and documentation updates per docs/IMPLEMENTATION-APPROACH.md.

Key checks:
- First run triggers setup wizard
- Config file created with secure permissions
- CLI flags override config values
- All error messages have actionable guidance
- Config validation and migration strategy
- All configuration options documented

title: Gate 6: Agent Write Review
description:
Quality gate after Iteration 6. Complete manual testing checklist, refactoring considerations, code quality checks, and documentation updates per docs/IMPLEMENTATION-APPROACH.md.

Key checks:
- Add/kill work from CLI and TUI
- Kill shows warning for active processes
- Shell escaping correct, no command injection
- Agent name sanitization
- Concurrent operations handled safely

title: Establish error handling patterns
description: Define consistent error handling approach before Iteration 1. Per Gate 1 refactoring considerations: establish error wrapping approach, define exit code constants (0=success, 1=error, 2=usage), create error types for different failure modes (cloud errors, SSH errors, config errors).

title: Create .pre-commit-config.yaml
description: Create pre-commit config with: pre-commit-hooks (trailing-whitespace, end-of-file-fixer, check-yaml, check-json, check-added-large-files, check-merge-conflict, detect-private-key, no-commit-to-branch), gofmt, goimports, golangci-lint (with HUMAN_HERE skip pattern), yamllint, actionlint, shellcheck, hadolint.

title: Testing Infrastructure
description: Set up testing infrastructure for Go: test directory structure, coverage reporting configuration, test helper utilities, and integration with CI pipeline.

title: Gate 4: SSH Integration Review
description:
Quality gate after Iteration 4. Complete manual testing checklist, refactoring considerations, code quality checks, and documentation updates per docs/IMPLEMENTATION-APPROACH.md.

Key checks:
- SSH works with various key types and SSH agent
- Connection errors handled gracefully
- SSH client abstracted for testing
- No shell injection vulnerabilities
- SSH keys never logged
- Firewall requirements documented

title: Create scripts/setup.sh
description: Create setup script for local development environment: check Go version, install pre-commit, run pre-commit install, install golangci-lint, run go mod download. Use set -euo pipefail and include helpful error messages.

title: Create test directory structure
description: Set up Go test directory structure with: internal packages for unit tests (tests alongside code), testdata/ for fixtures, and integration/ for integration tests. Create example test file demonstrating patterns.

title: Initialize go.mod
description: Initialize Go module with go mod init. Choose appropriate module path (e.g., github.com/yourorg/cloudcoop). Add initial dependencies: cobra (CLI), bubbletea (TUI), lipgloss (styling).

title: Create release workflow
description: Create .github/workflows/release.yml triggered on tag push (v*). Use GoReleaser action to build and publish releases. Include checksum generation and signature if needed.

title: Final Review: MVP Readiness
description:
Final quality gate before release. Complete end-to-end scenarios, performance checks, security review, and release checklist per docs/IMPLEMENTATION-APPROACH.md.

End-to-end scenarios:
- New user setup flow
- Daily workflow (start VM, add agents, work, stop)
- Monitoring workflow (TUI, view agents, kill/add)
- Scripting workflow (CLI commands, JSON output)

Checks:
- TUI startup <500ms, status refresh <2s
- No memory leaks during extended use
- No credentials in logs or error messages
- Binary size <20MB
- All platforms build and work

title: Establish logging patterns (zerolog/slog)
description: Decide on and implement the logging library for cloudcoop. Gate 1 mentions this decision needs to be made before Iteration 1. Options: zerolog (popular, fast), slog (stdlib in Go 1.21+). Establish patterns for log levels, structured fields, and where logging should occur.

title: Create .yamllint.yaml configuration
description: Create yamllint config extending default with: line-length max 160, truthy check-keys false, comments min-spaces-from-content 1.

title: Iteration 5: Agent Sessions (Read)
description:
Prove tmux integration and output parsing.

Deliverables:
- cloudcoop agents list executes tmux list-windows, parses output
- Display: window index, name, current command, duration
- TUI displays agent list in main view
- Handle 'no tmux session' case gracefully
- Handle 'tmux not installed' case

Proves: Remote command output parsing, tmux protocol understanding, session state representation.

Exit criteria: User sees list of tmux windows (or empty state message).

title: Create test helper utilities
description: Create internal/testutil package with common test helpers: mock SSH client, test fixtures loader, assertion helpers for TUI components (bubbletea tea.Model testing).

title: Gate 2: Cloud Integration Review
description:
Quality gate after Iteration 2. Complete manual testing checklist, refactoring considerations, code quality checks, and documentation updates per docs/IMPLEMENTATION-APPROACH.md.

Key checks:
- Status works with valid/invalid/missing credentials
- Cloud provider interface abstracted for future AWS/Azure
- No hardcoded project IDs or credentials
- Unit tests use mock GCP client
- Prerequisites and troubleshooting documented
